claim: A dev-dev review round mints no thread and is cited by `commit:`/PR; only operator-in-the-loop design deliberation mints a thread. A review round is never persisted in a thread, with no embedded-exception clause; a mixed session excises its review half to a PR comment and finalizes only the design half.

evidence.detail: Staged and grounded in the council-mechanism proto-belief document: threads persist operator deliberation, not agent-agent review noise; the tiering rule keeps the thread shelf a record of design decisions.
Enforced on its own founding session: the 2026-07-04 council-design thread excised its dev-dev audit half to PR #20 and finalized only the design half - the rule in force before it was minted.
